newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start firm but quiet.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start firm but quiet.

text.p: European meals and feeds started off quietly on Friday, with South American soybeanmeal offered at higher prices on the back of the firm Chicago close.
But there were few early takers and the only trade noted in initial European dealings was for afloat Argentine sunmeal, a product that enjoyed reasonable offtake on Thursday.

Traders said Thursday's steadier Chicago close than of late would probably hamper European physical business today, as buyers waited to see how markets reacted to the USDA crop figures due on Tuesday next week.
